Question: assalamalaykum i want to know that (1)khane se pahle kya fateha dilana jayaz hai.kya prophet islam ne khane mai fateha di thi. (2)kya kabra/mazar per fateha padhna jayaz hai.kya prophet islam ne kabra/mazar per fateha di thi. jazakumullah Answer ID: 4505 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1335/1003=H/1429) The prevalent fatiha is innovation in religion, thus unlawful. It is not proved from the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ), his companions and their successors. (2) The reply is same as above. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
